title: Rook vs King
summary: Learn the beginner-friendly plan for checkmating with a rook and king against a lone king.
objectives: Use the rook to cut the king off

steps.title: The rook cuts off space
steps.body: A rook is great at blocking ranks and files. Use it to fence the enemy king in before trying to mate.

steps.title: Your king still matters
steps.body: The rook alone cannot checkmate. Your king must step in and help take away escape squares.

steps.title: Basic winning setup
steps.coach_note: The rook controls space from far away. The king must march forward to help finish the position.

steps.title: Think in boxes
steps.coach_note: Like queen vs king, the idea is to make the enemy king's safe area smaller. The rook helps build the wall.

steps.title: What is the winning method?
steps.question: In rook vs king, what should you usually do first?
options: Cut off the king and bring your king in
steps.answer: Cut off the king and bring your king in

feedback.correct: Correct. Restriction first, then king support, then mate.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. Endless checks are not the real method.

steps.title: Lesson recap
steps.body: Use the rook to reduce the enemy king's space, bring your king closer, and finish with a clean mate.
